kjv: the second man [is] the Lord from heaven
mine: the second man is from heaven
note: TR adds "ho kyrios"; absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, B, C, D*, F, G.

kjv: we shall also bear the image of the heavenly
mine: let us also bear the image of the man of heaven
note: SBLGNT follows the better-attested subjunctive "phoresomen" (P46, Sinaiticus, A, C, D, F, G) against TR future "phoresomen" (B); the difference is one vowel, so many editors prefer the future on contextual grounds.

kjv: O death, where [is] thy sting? O grave, where [is] thy victory?
mine: O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting?
note: TR has "hade" (grave/Hades) in the second line, from Hos 13:14 LXX, and reverses the order; P46, Sinaiticus, B, C read "death" twice.
